thread:
mia.g: Drafting a package spec for Redwood Optimize quant profiles — want feedback before I formalize naming and recommendations. TL;DR: two artifact types (candidate qpkg + signed release manifest), semantic versioning, compatibility matrix, and a small metadata schema. :memo:
sam.k: SGTM. Can you paste the proposed metadata schema?
mia.g: sure — rough sketch:
```
name: string # e.g. 'ggml-gpt4all-13b-awq'
version: string # semver, e.g. 1.0.0
backend: string # 'awq' | 'gptq' | 'int8' | 'fp8'
precision: string # 'g8' | 'w8a8' etc
profile_id: string # optimize profile UUID
accuracy_delta: string # e.g. '-0.6% on PIQA v2'
calib_data: url | null
compat: [string] # list of deployment profiles (hosted,dedicated,private)
notes: string
```
olivia.p: Love the manifest. A couple of asks: 1) include `eval_suite` name and commit hash, 2) add `recommended_routes` (like low_latency|low_cost) so Console can suggest defaults.
mia.g: good call. I'll add `eval_suite` and `recommended_routes`.
ben_r: On naming, prefer `pkg` over `qpkg` for shorter references in logs. Also think we should encode backend+precision in a normalized slug: `<model>-<backend>-v<semver>` e.g. `mistral-7b-awq-v1.0.0`.
lina: Operational constraints: include `max_tokens_latency` and `throughput_target` fields so Dedicated autoscaler can pick pools. 
qa-bot: automated note: when adding `accuracy_delta`, please specify metric and dataset format: `metric:name:value` e.g. `accuracy:piqa:-0.6` for machine parsing. :robot_face:
sam.k: Regarding compatibility, how do we express fallback order? e.g. prefer AWQ, fallback GPTQ, then FP8?
mia.g: thinking `compat` be ordered list of profile IDs. And add `fallback_policy: enum` with values `{best_effort,strict_order,prefer_latency}`.
ben_r: For Redwood Optimize recommendations, we should include suggested `quantization_config` snippet so Optimize can propose it automatically. Example:
```
quantization_config:
  method: awq
  block_size: 128
  per_channel: true
  act-order: 2
```
lina: Also add `safety_flags` list for any known regressed prompts or categories. important for quality gating.
olivia.p: One operational flow question: when packaging a candidate qpkg, should we require an internal `qc_pass` tag from eval jobs? I vote yes — at minimum smoke tests pass + no regression > 1% on primary metrics.
mia.g: Agreed — `qc_status` with values `{pending,smoke_fail,regression,pass}`. We'll gate release manifests on `pass`.
deploy-bot: deploy note: new qpkg schema accepted by package-service v0.9. If you bump manifest fields, update the package-service client. :hammer_and_wrench:
mia.g: Regarding naming/versioning policy: semver for the package (artifact) separate from model weights model_version. So manifest will include `model_version` and `pkg_version`. Keep pkg_version bump for any packaging metadata change (even if weights same).
sam.k: How are we surfacing accuracy deltas in Optimize? small text field or machine-readable?
mia.g: both — human `accuracy_delta` string and machine `accuracy_delta_struct` like `metric:name:value:seed` so Automations can alert if delta crosses thresholds.
ben_r: rollout naming: recommend `pkg_channel` values `{canary,stable,experimental}` in manifest so Console mapping to rollouts is direct.
lina: Request: add `hardware_profiles` allowed list (e.g., a100-80gb, h100-80gb, t4) so runtime can filter incompatible packages.
mia.g: will add. Final question: file extension and artifact layout — single tarball `pkg.tar.gz` containing: `{model.bin, manifest.json, qmeta.json, checksums.txt}`. Thoughts?
olivia.p: OK. For checksums, SHA256 per file. And include signed manifest (`manifest.sig`) for enterprise/private deployment verification.
qa-bot: test vector: when `backend=gptq` and `precision=int8`, ensure validation runner rejects mismatched combos. I'll add unit tests to `optimize/evals/validators`.
sam.k: Last nit: recommend `pkg` filename include short hash and semver: `mistral-7b-awq-v1.0.0-3f2a1b.pkg.tar.gz` to avoid collisions.
mia.g: thanks all — I'll iterate and push a PR with the full schema + a sample manifest and an end-to-end bakeoff checklist. Expect PR by EOD. :raised_hands:
